mapper.select: SELECT id FROM travel_plan_members WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, title, completed, version FROM travel_plan_checklist WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, completed, version FROM travel_plan_checklist WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT content, version FROM travel_plan_notices WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId}
SELECT id, title, amount, memo, version FROM travel_plan_expenses WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, amount, memo, version FROM travel_plan_expenses WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_checklist SET title = #{title}, completed = #{completed}, version = version + 1 WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM travel_plan_checklist WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_notices (travel_plan_id, content) VALUES (#{planId}, '') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE travel_plan_id = travel_plan_notices.travel_plan_id
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_notices SET content = #{content}, version = version + 1 WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_expenses (travel_plan_id, title, amount, memo) VALUES (#{planId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{memo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM travel_plan_expenses WHERE travel_plan_id = #{planId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
